about: Effects spawned off-screen (sperm drips, icon pop-ups: obj_empty) run their step and end while culling is off (the default), like the cells that spawn them. Regression: obj_empty's step skipped off-screen instances regardless of the culling toggle, so every drip and pop-up from an off-screen cell stayed forever; a big nest gained ~1 instance per frame and its frame time grew for hours. One of each is created far below the view with the game's own functions; both must be gone after their lifetime (pop-up 60 frames, landed drip at most 600).

steps.why: control: a fresh nest has none
